Two bodies, including a child's, found in sacks in Kerala river

Two bodies, one identified as that of a child, were discovered stuffed inside sacks in the Attappadi river. Police are investigating the incident and are reportedly closing in on clues. Initial suspicions suggest a migrant worker may be involved.
